name: Rage
description: The Rage was an Imperial Navy Lancer-class frigate that was stationed in 0 ABY alongside two IPV-1 System Patrol Craft, Green/Aura and Green/Besh, at the Galactic Empire's Bavos-II military space platform Station 1B6/Green, on the edge of the Core Worlds' Ringali Nebula. The Rage had 20 Quad laser cannons, and, as a Lancer-class frigate, was manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards. It measured 250 meters long.
